experimentTypes: [ { "name": "Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics" } ]

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) workflow using DDA and spectral counting for quantification. While the study discusses H3K36me3 and H3K79me2, these were analyzed via ChIP-seq, not the proteomics assay. The proteomics search parameters explicitly listed oxidized methionine as a variable modification.

scope: single-step STREP-Tactin purifications of MLL-fusion proteins were performed
Protein complexes around MLL-fusion proteins were purified from nuclear lysates
Bound proteins were eluted by the addition of 100 μl 2.5 mM Biotin (Alfa Aesar) in TNN-HS buffer. Samples were digested with trypsin and processed for LC-MS/MS analysis.
subcellular_fraction: Nuclear extracts from transgene-expressing Jurkat cells were prepared
Nuclei were collected by centrifugation (500×g for 5 min)
For the extraction of nuclear proteins, nuclei were resuspended in buffer C420
the protein concentration of the soluble nuclear fraction was measured by Bradford assay

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was specifically affinity-purified MLL-fusion protein complexes derived from nuclear extracts.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is an AP-MS survey comparing the interactomes of seven different MLL-fusion proteins against control purifications. While the paper later performs shRNA and CRISPR screens (SETD2 loss), those are separate functional assays and not the primary MS-analyzed samples described in the PRIDE dataset PXD009338.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was used on an Orbitrap Velos. While the original analysis used spectral counting, the data is suitable for label-free quantification (LFQ) reanalysis.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment is explicitly described as affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry (AP-MS) using Strep-Tactin beads to pull down MLL-fusion proteins.

workflow: single-step STREP-Tactin purifications of MLL-fusion proteins were performed

differential: fitting the MS data to the generalized linear statistical model: log(data) ~ A0, j + Ai, j + αi + βi, k, where A0, j is the logarithm of the baseline abundance of the j-th prey protein (estimated from the control AP-MS experiments)
search_parameters: Carbamidomethyl cysteine and oxidized methionine were set as fixed and variable modifications, respectively

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The original study used a complex generalized linear model to distinguish specific interactors from background using spectral counts. Reanalysis should focus on protein-level abundance/counts.
